faqs.a:
Any notice served in accordance with provisions of this chapter shall contain a specific
               description of the work to be done, the plans and specifications to be followed or
               the place where the same may be obtained, and shall specify the time within which
               such required repairs or reconstruction shall be completed, or if a hearing is conducted,
               such repair or reconstruction shall be completed as determined by the hearing.
(
Ord. No. 4365, § 1, 11-19-2012
)
